value.rationale: On metric networks the vertex-continuous linear finite-element projector is a natural least-squares reconstruction. The exact branch-degree stability law reveals a strictly increasing departure from the line benchmark, approaches the optimal universal envelope 3 through finite trees, and has a quantitative transfer principle to finite high-girth networks. This is a structural infinite-family stability result, not a single cheap numerical calculation.
